authority.destructive_boundary: Only managed dsh-remote files, profile entry, DNS record, socket directory, and marked Nginx/Compose blocks may be added, replaced, or rolled back; existing unrelated sites, containers, certificates, data, and firewall rules must not be deleted or changed.

intent.goal: Deliver and verify a DSH 0.1.0-rc.6 remote-access plugin and reversible HTTPS edge at zsh.onlyservice.io through vps-tencent-tokyo.
non_goals: Persisting DSH data on the VPS
Automatic changes outside zsh.onlyservice.io and the managed dsh-remote edge

acceptance: US-R1 private fragment link establishes a secure session and complete DSH HTTP/WebSocket access through HTTPS.
US-R2 status/copy/rotation works and rotation invalidates old links, cookies, and established upgraded sockets.
US-R3 tunnel or DSH absence produces the designed public 503 page without infrastructure leakage.
outcome.first_evidence: Committed approved baseline, design, implementation plan, and verified environment constraints.

recovery.failure_strategy: Stop before reload on failed preflight or validation; restore exact timestamped Nginx/Compose backups, remove only managed profile/DNS entries when rollback is requested, validate, and retain unrelated state.
recovery.maintenance_window: Apply only after local tests and review candidate converge; brief Nginx reload/container recreate is allowed during final deployment.
